summary: Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. and Brookfield Infrastructure Corporation filed a 6-K attaching a November 5, 2026 press release confirming all required approvals to complete their previously announced simplification, collapsing BIP and BIC into a single entity, Brookfield Infrastructure Partners Inc. (BIP Inc.), expected to close November 19, 2026. Existing securityholders receive BIP Inc. Class A shares one-for-one; no Q4 2026 distribution is declared pending closing, with a US$0.455 quarterly dividend intended thereafter, and BIP's DRIP terminated November 5, 2026. Class A shares should trade on NYSE/TSX under BIP around November 23, 2026. Watch conversion mechanics, TSX issuer-bid acceptance and index flows.
